GOGO_ENV: Application environment; production disables development reload and enables production checks in wired connectors.
GOGO_DEBUG: Application debug flag; must be false to pass deployment checks. Does not install a debug error page.
GOGO_SECRET_KEY: Secret used to sign and verify application data, including session cookies; at least 32 bytes.
GOGO_SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS: Previous signing keys for rotation; your project must parse this value and supply key IDs and expiry times to the signer.
GOGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS: Comma-separated hostnames accepted by the HTTP host-validation middleware.
GOGO_TRUSTED_PROXIES: Comma-separated proxy CIDR networks allowed to supply forwarded client and protocol information.
GOGO_HTTP_ADDR: Host and port on which the HTTP server listens; use 0.0.0.0:8000 inside a container.
GOGO_HTTP_READ_HEADER_TIMEOUT: Maximum time the HTTP server allows for reading request headers.
GOGO_HTTP_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Maximum time an HTTP keep-alive connection can wait for the next request.
GOGO_MAX_BODY_BYTES: Request-body size limit in bytes, when passed to body-reading middleware or handlers.
GOGO_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES: Upload size limit in bytes, when passed to your upload handler or storage configuration.
GOGO_DATABASE_URL: PostgreSQL connection string containing the server, database, credentials and connection options.
GOGO_DB_MAX_OPEN: Maximum number of open database connections in each process's connection pool.
GOGO_DB_MAX_IDLE: Maximum idle database connections retained for reuse; cannot exceed GOGO_DB_MAX_OPEN.
GOGO_DB_MAX_LIFETIME: Maximum lifetime of a pooled database connection before it is replaced.
GOGO_DB_QUERY_TIMEOUT: Timeout budget for application database work; your project must apply it to contexts or handlers, not a global SQL timeout.
GOGO_REDIS_URL: Redis connection URL, including credentials and the database number used to isolate application data; no application namespace is added.
GOGO_REDIS_OPERATION_TIMEOUT: Redis connection and I/O timeout when supplied to the connector.
GOGO_SESSION_BACKEND: Session storage choice; your project must construct and connect the selected backend.
GOGO_SESSION_TTL: Session lifetime passed to session middleware; the default is 14 days.
GOGO_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME: Browser cookie name used by session middleware.
GOGO_PASSWORD_RESET_TTL: Reserved password-reset lifetime setting; the current built-in reset service uses a fixed one-hour expiry and does not read this value.
GOGO_AUTH_TOKEN_TTL: Lifetime of issued API tokens when passed to auth.TokensConfig.TTL.
GOGO_RESET_DELIVERY_KEY_REF: Reserved encryption-key reference for a project-provided reset-delivery resource; does not enable encrypted background delivery by itself.
GOGO_CACHE_TTL: Default lifetime for cached values when passed to the cache service.
GOGO_CACHE_FAILURE_POLICY: Optional-cache outage policy: bypass loads from the source; fail returns the cache error. Wire it to Cache.BypassUnavailable.
GOGO_SMTP_HOST: Hostname of the SMTP server used to send email.
GOGO_SMTP_PORT: Port of the SMTP server; the default is 587.
GOGO_SMTP_USERNAME: Username for SMTP authentication, if required by the mail provider.
GOGO_SMTP_PASSWORD: Password for SMTP authentication, if required by the mail provider.
GOGO_MAIL_FROM: Sender email address to pass to outgoing mail and account-email services.
GOGO_STORAGE_ROOT: Existing private directory for local file storage; pass it to files.LocalConfig.Directory.
GOGO_STATIC_ROOT: Destination directory for collected static assets; pass it to the static collection configuration.
GOGO_MEDIA_PUBLIC: Application flag for a project-provided public-media policy; does not expose files or bypass download authorization automatically.
GOGO_LOG_LEVEL: Minimum severity for your application's logger when wired into its logging configuration.
GOGO_SHUTDOWN_GRACE: Time allowed for graceful HTTP shutdown and application resource cleanup before cancellation.
